profile.headline: Retire Senior Software Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.summary:
I am HeuPao Peter Lee (also known as Pao Lee or Peter Lee).  I have a Doctor of Philosophy degree in computer science, and more than 30 years of experience in the area of software design and development, data warehouse design and development, combine with technical systems analyst and the following management (soft) skills. 

SUMMARY of SOFT (MANAGEMENT) SKILLS:
•	Fifteen plus years of business knowledge in the area of financial services (insurance, and banking) industry. 
•	Eight plus years of business knowledge in the area of electric utility industry.
•	Several years’ business knowledge in retail, and healthcare industries.
•	Five plus years as Senior Consultant/Staff Manager/Project Lead.
•	Fifteen plus years as Application Developer/Lead.
•	One plus years as an adjunct faculty at Metropolitan State University.
•	Fifteen plus years as community leader/advisor
•	Served as President for Hmong Lee USA, Inc. (a non-profit organization) from 06/2012 to  06/2016.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Mainframe (COBOL, CICS,  DB2, JCL, etc.), programmer.

positions.title: Applications Consultant
positions.description: Worked at US Bank as an Applications Consultant. General batch  COBOL/DB2 programming

positions.title: President of Hmong Lee USA, Inc.
positions.description: Former President of Hmong Lee USA, Inc. (HLUSA) a non-profit organization. HLUSA is a new established non-profit organization to unify Hmong Lee across the USA. See our website at www.hmongleeusa.com for more information about our organization.
